description: This file defines a React functional component for user interface preferences related to creating new notes, including selection of default editor and title format, with support for dynamic updates and locale-specific date formatting.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the properties expected by the NewNotePreferences component, including application context, selected tag, mode, callback, and disabled flag.

methods.name: NewNotePreferences
methods.description: React functional component rendering UI for note creation preferences, managing state for editor selection and title format, with effects for synchronization and debounce handling for custom format input.

methods.name: setNewNoteTitleFormatChange
methods.description: Handler function that updates the new note title format in state and persists it via preferences or callback based on mode.

methods.name: handleCustomFormatInputChange
methods.description: Debounced handler updating custom note title format in state and preferences.
